answer: Each identity earns weight only by stewarding one garden plot for a 45-day season. The steward registers the plot, repairs its trellis, and files photo logs plus a sparrow nesting count checked by two neighbours staking their own standing. One plot backs one identity; duplicate plots or copied logs fail audit. An attacker pays 800 units bond plus 120 units for supplies per fake, and waits 45 days before any weight accrues. Stand-ins do not help: each needs its own plot, bond and season, so 100 fakes cost 92,000 units and 100 plots, and a failed audit burns the bond and blacklists it.
